items.q: We was in Boy Scouts together, Troop 533, Ebenezer Baptist Church.

ctx.x: Lester Young‟s manager after a while.
Yeah. We was in Boy Scouts together, Troop 533, Ebenezer Baptist Church. He was on the door at the Regal so I could go in and out of there at the time we were Boy Scouts.
Was he any kind of a musician at all?
